# ARC: dominant background and sparse marks

When demonstrations show a two-color grid where the dominant color is replaced by 0 and sparse cells of the other color are changed to the former dominant color, apply that mapping cellwise to the test grid.

## Procedure
1. Compare colors and counts in demo inputs and outputs.
2. Check whether the dominant input color becomes 0 while the minority color becomes the original dominant color.
3. Confirm the same relation on every demo (the exact colors can vary across tasks/instances).
4. Apply the mapping to every test cell without changing dimensions or positions.

Example: if input has dominant 7 and sparse 5, output has background 0 and sparse marks 7. For a test grid with dominant 5 and sparse 4, map 5→0 and 4→5.
